mode.description: Mode of operation; 'daemon' runs as a background service.

host.description: IP address the server listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: Port number for the HTTP server.

db_path.description: Path to the main database directory.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

request_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a client request before timing out.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Higher levels reduce log volume.

query_log.description: Whether to log all incoming queries for debugging and auditing.

access_log.description: Whether to log access information (requests, responses, timing).

log_dir.description: Directory where query and access logs are stored.

search_max_n_records.description: Maximum number of matching records returned per search result.

use_thread_pool.description: Whether to use a thread pool for parallel request handling.

n_workers.description: Number of worker threads when thread pool is enabled.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for secure connections.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

vhosts.description: List of virtual host configurations. Each entry defines an independent virtual host.

name.description: Logical name for the virtual host (e.g., 'main', 'backup').

host.description: Host address to bind for this virtual host (e.g., 'localhost'). If omitted, inherits global 'host'.

port.description: Port for this virtual host. If omitted, inherits global 'port'.

db_path.description: Path to the database directory for this virtual host. If omitted, inherits global 'db_path'.

ssl_enabled.description: Override global SSL setting for this virtual host. Null to inherit.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file specific to this virtual host.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file specific to this virtual host.

plugins.description: List of Groonga plugins to load at startup. Each item specifies a plugin name.

name.description: Name of the plugin to load (e.g., 'log', 'status', 'mmap').
